**ACCEPT** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, review of record) — PR #4186.

The dispatch's "read why it reloads before deciding" clause earned its keep: the reload is load-bearing for a measured reason (MetadataProvider mounts on auth RESOLUTION and re-keys on language alone, so a router navigation would hand the new owner an appless console) — both exits stay assigns, base-prefixed, with the rationale pinned on the constant so the next refactorer inherits the WHY. Two card corrections reported straight: the third private copy of the helper in RegisterPage (the predicted drift had already happened — the lift covers three sites), and the verification that the helper's mechanism actually holds (BASE_URL vs injected base href are different sources that agree because Vite 8 resolves `./` literally — documented, because without that fact the fix would be theatre). The test design matches the mechanism: targets resolved against document.baseURI as location.assign itself resolves them, across all three real mount configurations. Reverse verification predicted 4-red exactly with the lift proven behavior-neutral by the seven untouched pins. The location.assign sweep's per-site verdicts (OAuth targets external by design; the storage URL server-prefixed) recorded in #4190 so nobody re-chases them, with #4190's own submitBehavior.url contract question correctly held for a ruling.

First-run owners on mounted consoles now land inside the SPA. Flipping ready + auto-merge.
